name: Remote MCP server
description: Connect to a remote MCP server. TITAN lists its tools and calls one.

auth.setupNote: Paste the https address of the MCP endpoint. Paste a bearer token if the server needs one. TITAN checks the host on each call.

fields.name: token
fields.label: Bearer token
fields.help: Leave it empty if the server needs no token.

actions.title: Refresh the tool list
actions.description: Reads the tool list from the server and keeps it. Each tool gets a risk that you can change.

actions.title: Call a tool
actions.description: The tool runs on the remote server. The risk of the tool decides if it needs approval. The default is write. A sub-agent cannot use this action.
